Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one pixel-art iPhone Home Screen app-icon concept for the cozy surgery-clinic management game Stitchin' Time. Create ONE 1024x1024 opaque full-bleed square image with no rounded corners.
Input image 1 is a REFERENCE BOARD of the game's approved cream-stone frontage walls, dark clinic-green posts, paving, and flower beds. Its pale checker patches are source-atlas background: ignore them completely.
Input image 2 is a REFERENCE BOARD of the actual approved Front Desk v4 room and in-game furniture. Use its materials, recognizable furniture silhouettes and colorful palette. Translate the top-down room into a front-facing view THROUGH A PHYSICALLY OPEN EXTERIOR DOOR; do not reproduce the reference board or its overhead map view.
Primary subject: a stylized small clinic storefront viewed from OUTSIDE, with its front door swung wide open and the in-game Front Desk clearly visible INSIDE. The large open doorway and the desk are the focal points. The desk stays inside the building behind the threshold. Show a cream desktop, deep teal-green desk front, a bold dark computer monitor, a small dark telephone, a large cream clock with dark rim on the rear wall, a recognizable BLUE water cooler on the rear right, and a leafy plant in a cream pot on the left. The warm interior has cream walls and a small patch of large cream floor tiles. The clock uses simple ticks, no digits. The clock, cooler and plant should be simplified for icon scale.
Style: faithful cozy game pixel art, strong dark outlines and clean blocky silhouettes. Draw like an intentional 128x128 pixel design enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Bold large pixel clusters, crisp stair-step edges, limited stepped shading. Warm cream, deep clinic green, rich wood browns, lively blue-teal furniture, honey-gold light and peach/coral flowers. Avoid monochrome gray-green, blurry painted texture, thin details or realistic rendering.
Composition: all essential building, open door and furniture inside the central approximately 80% of the square. A continuous solid colored background reaches all four edges. The icon must read immediately at 60x60: prioritize the bright rectangular doorway, broad desk and black monitor, then the clock and cooler. Leave enough visible floor and a threshold to show that the reception desk is inside a room, not an outdoor stall.
Text: NONE, no lettering, no signs, no numbers. No people, faces or silhouettes; no blood or gore; no logos, brands, Star of Life or other trademarked medical symbols; no watermark; no border, transparency, inset icon tile, contact sheet, captions or mockup phone.
